nodes.label: Android Adaptive Icon Background Asset
nodes.description: 512x512 background layer for the Finance Buddy Android adaptive launcher icon. Content is a flat pale-blue field overlaid with faint blue vector construction geometry: two concentric circles centered slightly above the optical middle, a dashed vertical center axis, a solid full-width horizontal axis, a dashed isoceles triangle whose apex sits on the outer circle's top and whose legs run past the canvas edge, and a small ring marking the exact center point. No brand mark, glyph, or wordmark is present - the foreground layer supplies those.
nodes.rationale: Android adaptive icons are composed of separate background and foreground layers so the launcher can mask, scale, and animate them independently; this file is deliberately mark-free and edge-to-edge so any OEM mask shape (circle, squircle, rounded square, teardrop) crops cleanly without clipping a logo.

nodes.label: Adaptive Icon Background Layer Pattern
nodes.description: The two-layer Android launcher icon convention in which a full-bleed background image is paired with a separately supplied foreground image, and the OS applies a device-specific mask over the composite.
nodes.rationale: Splitting background from foreground lets the OS guarantee a consistent icon silhouette across OEM skins and enables parallax/scale motion on the two layers, at the cost of requiring the background to carry no meaningful detail near its edges.

nodes.label: Icon Safe Zone Construction Guides
nodes.description: The concentric circles, center-point ring, vertical/horizontal axes, and dashed triangle visible in the asset - a geometric layout scaffold indicating the maskable safe area and the alignment targets for the foreground mark.
nodes.rationale: Guides are kept in the shipped background at very low contrast rather than deleted so the alignment reference survives future foreground edits; the trade-off is that faint construction lines can become visible on high-contrast or color-inverted displays.

nodes.label: Brand Pale Blue Fill
nodes.description: The flat light/pale blue field covering the entire canvas, acting as the app's launcher-icon brand color and the contrast substrate for the foreground mark.
nodes.rationale: A single flat low-saturation tint (rather than a gradient or photographic fill) keeps the icon legible at small launcher sizes, compresses to a tiny PNG, and survives OEM mask cropping without visible seams.

nodes.label: Optical Center Offset
nodes.description: The circle group and marked center ring sit slightly above the geometric middle of the 512px canvas rather than exactly on it.
nodes.rationale: Shifting the construction center above true center compensates for the perceived downward weight of a mark inside a masked circle, so the composited icon reads as vertically centered in the launcher grid even though it is not mathematically centered.
nodes.confidence_note: Offset is estimated visually from the rendered asset, not read from a spec file.
